explanation: States the generalised empty pentagon theorem (Abel et al. 2011, Theorem 3), the source of the ℓ ≤ 5 result cited in Green's Problem 70: for k ≥ 2, every sufficiently large finite P ⊆ ℝ² has k collinear points or an empty pentagon. HasEmptyPentagon asks for 5 points of P in convex position (ConvexIndependent) whose convex hull contains no other point of P, the standard notion of a 5-hole. Faithful.
